questions.question: In a prophecy of hope, the speaker says that though he sits in darkness, what will the LORD be to him?
A prophet says God does not hold on to His anger forever. Why does he say God does not?

answers.text: His people finally earned His favor

questions.question: A prophet says God will cast out all our sins. Where does he say God will throw them?

answers.text: Into the depths of the sea

questions.question: A prophet says God will show faithfulness to Jacob and loving devotion to Abraham. He calls it a brand new promise God never made before. True or false?
